cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline explanation layer helps novices understand consequential technical setup while a deterministic state machine retains exclusive authority over operations.

test_prompts.prompt: A synthetic setup record says the target identity and authorization are verified, but the original security-verifier baseline was never captured. Explain this state to a novice, name the missing evidence, and decide whether the workflow may continue. Do not provide commands or claim that a physical device was tested.

A synthetic setup record contains verified target identity, captured verifier baseline, successful restoration, a passed Play Protect scan, matching post-reboot verifier state, retained Device Owner status, and an exported observation digest. Explain what this establishes, what synthetic evidence cannot establish, and the safe final decision. Do not provide commands.
